text: @linxueyuan/dsh-git 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Git 工作台，作为官方右侧栏标签接入，并由宿主侧执行本地 Git 操作。它提供多仓库切换、文件差异查看与行级暂存、提交和分支同步，也可浏览 GitHub 上的代码、Issues、Pull requests 与 Actions；提交信息可由 DSH 已配置的模型生成。适合希望在 DSH 内管理本地代码仓库并处理 GitHub 协作事项的开发者。远端功能需要 GitHub 登录和仓库访问权限；设备码登录内置默认 App，也可使用 Personal Access Token。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git adds a Git workbench to the DSH Web sidebar. It supports local diffs, line staging, commits, branch sync, and GitHub code, issues, pull requests, and Actions. DSH can generate commit messages with a configured model. Remote features require GitHub sign-in.
我想在 DSH 侧栏里查看和暂存 Git 改动。
能不能只把文件里选中的几行加入暂存区？
想从 DSH 管理几个本地仓库的提交和分支同步。
有没有办法在工作台里看 GitHub issue 并添加评论？
希望在 DSH 里浏览和处理 GitHub Pull request。
提交说明写起来费劲，能否让已配置的模型根据改动生成一条？
I want to review and stage selected lines from a change inside DSH.
Can I browse GitHub pull requests and their checks from my DSH workspace?
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 的功能「本地变更与行级暂存」：在 Changes 视图查看仓库改动和 diff，并可将选中的行暂存；对二进制文件则提示改用整文件暂存。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 的功能「提交本地改动」：用户在 Changes 提交区输入摘要和描述后提交当前暂存内容；提交摘要为空时会返回输入错误。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 的功能「同步分支」：在本地 Git 工作台执行 push；没有 upstream 时会设置 upstream，遇到分离头或无提交等状态会提示不能推送。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 的功能「查看 GitHub Issues」：在 Issues 页签列出 issue，并提供详情抽屉；该视图还支持新建、评论、编辑和关闭或重开 issue。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 的功能「查看 Pull requests 与检查状态」：Pull requests 页签展示列表和详情抽屉，并集成检查状态摘要；用户可新建、评论、合并或关闭 PR。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git 使用前须知：Issues、Pull requests 与 Actions 等远端功能需要 GitHub 登录并具备相应仓库访问权限；本地 Git 工作台本身可用于本地仓库。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 你会得到：

另外这些是所有页签共用的：

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 你会得到：- **多仓库下拉** —— 你显式添加过的本地仓库；登录 GitHub 后还能列出你有权限的远端仓库。
- **同步与分支** —— fetch / pull / push；强推只允许 `--force-with-lease`（全库没有裸 `--force`）。分支可切换、新建、重命名，也能检出某个提交（分离头）或 cherry-pick。
- **没有远端也能用** —— Code 页签在本地仓库上退化为本地工作区视图，不是空页；Issues / PR / Actions 需要远端，缺远端时给的是可读说明而不是报错。
- **提交信息交给模型** —— host 半读 diff，走 `ctx.llm` 里你已经在 DSH 配好的任意 provider。
- **设置里能找到它** —— 侧栏「插件」页 ▸「已安装」▸ `@linxueyuan/dsh-git` ▸ 详情页的**配置区**：界面缩放、diff 勾选标记、通知与几个确认开关，外加插件自己的配置文档（Pulls 自动刷新周期）。GitHub Desktop 那几页偏好仍在右侧栏齿轮里。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 它是怎么做的：

一个 npm 包里是两个半边：**浏览器半**只画界面（注册官方右侧栏 tab，本地操作走 `/dsh-git/*`），**host 半**与 dsh 同进程，跑 git、注册路由、保管令牌、调模型。远端页签不直接打 GitHub，而是由 host 半代理，令牌因此从不进入浏览器。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 它是怎么做的：- `/dsh-git/*` 只接受 **loopback** 请求；局域网 / 远程访问一律 403。
- git 只能操作**你显式添加过的仓库**清单里的路径（其他路径返回 `workspace-unknown`）。
- clone 关掉 `protocol.ext.*`。
- 令牌只存在 host，读 / 写 / 日志只有一处：`src/host/credential-bridge.ts`。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 安装：```bash
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 从 npm 安装(npm 包名是 scoped 的 @linxueyuan/dsh-git)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @linxueyuan/dsh-git

text:
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · GitHub 登录与令牌：```yaml
- id: dsh-git
  name: '@linxueyuan/dsh-git'
  config:
    clientId: 'Ov23li…'   # 自己建的 App 的 Client ID

令牌只在 host 侧，浏览器只看得到尾 4 位；静止时是**明文 + `0600` 权限**，没有加密。
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 已知边界（M1）：- 远端页签以 GitHub 为准；本地未推送的提交在 Code 树里看不到对应文件。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 开发：```bash
npm install           # 依赖：esbuild（打包）+ typescript / eslint / sass（闸门）
npm run build         # lib/index.js(host, esm) + lib/client.js(browser, ModuleLoader 包装)
npm run check         # 产物语法检查（node --check）
npm run lint          # ESLint

**CI 只跑发布物**（构建 → 产物语法 → 包可用性：清单自洽、宿主能加载、运行时依赖都已声明、发布内容完整且不含源码）：

```bash
npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs
```

下面这些闸门是**本地的源码卫生工具**，不在 CI 里 —— 它们盯的是「这个仓库自己怎么写的」，
与「装上能不能用」无关，其中一部分是长期棘轮债：

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 开发：| 闸门 | 拦下的静默失败 |
|---|---|
| `check-integration` | 产物没跃升 / 镜像不可达 / 类名缺失 |
| `check-generated` | 生成物与源码不同步（`npm run check:generated:rebuild` 会重跑构建逐字节比对） |
| `check-base-recipes` | 类名在、但真正的样式配方不在编译闭包里 |
| `check-scope-roots` | 作用域根在同一条选择器里出现两次 ⇒ 永不匹配 |
| `check-sass-leaks` | 产物里残留未编码的 `$var` ⇒ 浏览器静默丢弃整条声明 |
| `check-unreachable-ancestors` | 规则在，但它要求的祖先元素从不渲染 |
| `check-lint` / `check-types` / `check-scripts-types` | ESLint / 客户端类型 / `scripts/**` 自己的类型 |
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · 开发：退出码契约：`0` = 通过（允许带**已登记**的棘轮债务）、`1` = 有**未登记**缺陷、`2` = 跳过。

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · @linxueyuan/dsh-git：**Local Git, inside the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar**: a multi-repo picker, local Changes / History work, Code / Issues / Pull requests / Actions tabs for the remote, and commit messages written by any model already configured in your DSH model list.
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · @linxueyuan/dsh-git：
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · What you get：

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · What you get：- **Multi-repo picker** — the local repositories you explicitly added; once you sign in to GitHub it can also list remote repositories you have access to.
- **Sync and branches** — fetch / pull / push. A force push is only ever `--force-with-lease` (there is no bare `--force` anywhere). Switch, create and rename branches; check out a commit (detached HEAD) or cherry-pick it.
- **Usable without a remote** — on a local-only repository the Code tab degrades to a local working-tree view rather than an empty page; Issues / PR / Actions need a remote and say so in plain language instead of erroring.
- **Commit messages come from the model** — the host half reads the diff and goes through `ctx.llm`, so it uses whichever provider you already configured in DSH.
- **Findable in settings** — sidebar Plugins page ▸ Installed ▸ `@linxueyuan/dsh-git` ▸ the configuration section on its detail page: interface scale, diff check marks, notifications and a few confirmation prompts, plus the plugin's own config document (Pulls auto-refresh interval). The ported GitHub Desktop preference pages stay behind the gear in the right sidebar.
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · How it works：

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · How it works：One npm package contains two halves. The **browser half** only draws UI (it registers the official sidebar tab; local actions go over `/dsh-git/*`). The **host half** runs in the same process as dsh: it runs git, registers routes, holds the token, and calls the model. Remote tabs never talk to GitHub directly — the host half proxies them, so the token never enters the browser.

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · How it works：- `/dsh-git/*` accepts **loopback** requests only; LAN and remote access get a 403.
- git can only touch paths from the list of repositories **you explicitly added** (anything else returns `workspace-unknown`).
- `clone` disables `protocol.ext.*`.
- The token lives in the host only, with a single read / write / log site: `src/host/credential-bridge.ts`.
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Install：```bash
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · from npm (the npm package name is scoped: @linxueyuan/dsh-git)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @linxueyuan/dsh-git

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · from a local directory (development)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-git
```

Note it is `@linxueyuan/dsh-git`, not the unscoped `dsh-git` — the latter was taken by someone else (a 0.0.1 placeholder package whose repository link 404s).

After installing, restart DSH and hard-refresh the page (the host half is a Node module and does not reload with a page refresh).

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · GitHub sign-in and tokens：Two ways to sign in: click **Sign in to GitHub.com** for device flow (works out of the box — the app ships with the package), or paste a **Personal Access Token** (a fine-grained token needs Contents R / Issues RW / Pull requests RW / Actions RW; a classic token needs `repo`).

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · GitHub sign-in and tokens：> ⚠️ The built-in app is a **GitHub App**: [install it](https://github.com/apps/dsh-git-local/installations/new) on your account / organization first — without an installation you sign in successfully but see no repositories. Its user tokens expire after 8 hours; the plugin refreshes them automatically.

To bring your own app, set `clientId` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, or provide the `DSH_GIT_CLIENT_ID` environment variable (`off` disables device flow).

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · GitHub sign-in and tokens：```yaml
- id: dsh-git
  name: '@linxueyuan/dsh-git'
  config:
    clientId: 'Ov23li…'   # Client ID of your own app

The token lives in the host only, the browser sees just its last 4 digits, and at rest it is **plaintext with `0600` permissions** — no encryption.

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Known limits (M1)：- Remote tabs are GitHub-only. And the Code tree is the remote's view: local commits that have not been pushed do not show up there as files.
- **The built-in app is a GitHub App**, so its repository access requires installing it first, and its user tokens expire after 8 hours (the plugin refreshes them automatically). Bringing your own OAuth App avoids the install step.

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Development：```bash
npm install           # deps: esbuild (bundling) + typescript / eslint / sass (gates)
npm run build         # lib/index.js (host, esm) + lib/client.js (browser, ModuleLoader-wrapped)
npm run check         # artifact syntax check (node --check)
npm run lint          # ESLint

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Development：**CI only checks the published artifact** (build → artifact syntax → package usability: manifest self-consistency, the host can load it, every runtime dependency is declared, and the tarball is complete and carries no source):

```bash
npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs
```

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Development：The gates below are **local source-hygiene tools, not CI** — they look at how this repository is written rather than at whether an install works, and some of them carry long-standing ratchet debt:

@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Development：| Gate | Silent failure it catches |
|---|---|
| `check-integration` | artifact not promoted / mirror unreachable / missing class names |
| `check-generated` | generated files out of sync with sources (`npm run check:generated:rebuild` re-runs the build and compares byte for byte) |
| `check-base-recipes` | the class exists but its real style recipe is outside the compiled closure |
| `check-scope-roots` | a scope root appearing twice in one selector ⇒ it can never match |
| `check-sass-leaks` | an unencoded `$var` left in the artifact ⇒ browsers silently drop the whole declaration |
| `check-unreachable-ancestors` | the rule exists but the ancestor element it requires never renders |
| `check-lint` / `check-types` / `check-scripts-types` | ESLint / client types / types of `scripts/**` itself |
@linxueyuan/dsh-git README · Development：Exit-code contract: `0` = pass (registered ratchet debt is allowed), `1` = an **unregistered** defect, `2` = skipped.
